assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Isosceles triangle ABC (sides 40, 40, 48) with its blue incircle centred at I; the red dashed radii to the base and to side AB, with the vertical one labelled r = 12; the tangent lengths are labelled x from B and C and y from A.

difficulty_rationale: One must recognise that area = 6 x perimeter means inradius 12, set up the tangent-length equation and solve the resulting Diophantine condition by factoring 576; a moderately demanding combination.
